//: Merge ONE of the entries below into your Claude Desktop config, then restart Claude Desktop.
//paths: Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/track-me-baby with wherever you cloned this repository. The paths must be absolute — Claude Desktop does not run in your project directory. On Windows use double backslashes, e.g. "C:\\code\\track-me-baby\\docker-compose.yml".
//docker: Use the 'track-me-baby' entry if you run the stack with docker compose. No build step is needed and each Claude Desktop launch creates a throwaway container against the same database. Configuration comes from docker-compose.yml, same as the long-running container.
//native: Use 'track-me-baby-native' instead if you run the tracker on the host (rename it to track-me-baby). Run 'dotnet build -c Release' first so the binary exists, and point at the binary rather than 'dotnet run' — dotnet run prints build messages to stdout, which corrupts the JSON-RPC stream. Note this entry gets no configuration from docker-compose.yml, because Claude Desktop launches it directly rather than through the start script; export GITHUB_TOKEN and the Tracker__* variables in your environment, or just use the Docker entry.
//note: Either way the HTTP host does not need to be running: Claude Desktop launches its own copy. The two coordinate through the database, so they never sync simultaneously.
